title: 7 Bike Parts Explain Every System in Science
description:
What is a system in science? A bike, your body and a tree all work the same way: parts with their own jobs, working together. Primary 4 Science (Singapore) and Grade 4 Science (US), explained for kids aged 9–12.

🚀 Revise with mind maps in TheOneApp, the ultimate science app: https://theoneapp-ten.vercel.app

0:00 Which bike part can you lose?
0:12 Welcome! What you'll learn today
0:30 The 7 parts of a bike
0:56 What is a system?
1:16 Pause and predict
1:49 If one part fails…
1:56 Systems in your body
2:34 A tree is a system too
2:57 Systems all around us
3:11 Exam corner: the model answer
3:26 Atomic habit: habit stacking
3:38 Make a mind map
4:02 The answer

In this episode you'll learn:
• A system is made up of different parts, and each part has its own function
• The parts work together to carry out a function
• If one part does not work, the whole system may be affected
• A preview of the respiratory, circulatory, skeletal, muscular and digestive systems, and the plant system

Follows the MOE Primary Science Syllabus 2023 (Systems theme) and links to NGSS 4-LS1-1.
Narration: computer-generated voice. Animation: original.

title: You Ate 3 Plant Parts Today. Which Ones?
description:
Plant parts and their functions: what do leaves, stems and roots do? Learn the 6 jobs of the plant system, plus an exam tip about roots that many students mix up. Primary 4 Science (Singapore) and Grade 4 Science (US), for kids aged 9–12.

In this episode you'll learn:
• Leaves make food and take in and give out gases
• The stem holds the plant upright and transports water, mineral salts and food
• Roots hold the plant firmly in the ground and absorb water and mineral salts
• Why fewer leaves means a plant grows less
